name: Shandong Nanshan Aluminium Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Nanshan Aluminium Co.,Ltd. engages in the aluminum processing business worldwide. The company offers upstream products, such as power generation, alumina, aluminum alloy ingots, and aluminum foil, as well as downstream products, including aluminum sheets and strips, which consist of automotive sheets, aviation sheets, and can materials; and industrial and building aluminum profiles.
